content_sections.text: A practising advocate A member of any State or Legal Authority, the State Legislature or Parliament A person dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired, or given a major penalty for misconduct, from State, Union or local authority service A person convicted of an offence involving moral delinquency, or charged with an offence of moral turpitude with proceedings pending Persons in a bigamous marriage, adjudicated insolvents, or contractors/businessmen interested in government contracts in the jurisdiction A person of unsound mind, deaf, mute, blind, or suffering from leprosy or any other contagious disease

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Judiciary Prakasam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 19 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for District Judiciary Prakasam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format enclosed with the notification (page 5 of the PDF)) and send it to Principal District and Sessions Judge, Ongole, Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh, by post or courier (postal/courier delays will not be considered), to reach by 19 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for District Judiciary Prakasam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 to 65 years (as on date of Notification).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.75,000 per month + Rs.10,000 per month conveyance for Special Judicial Magistrate of II-Class at Chirala, Rs.75,000 per month + Rs.10,000 per month conveyance for Special Judicial Magistrate of II-Class at Giddalur, Rs.75,000 per month + Rs.10,000 per month conveyance for Special Judicial Magistrate of II-Class at Kandukur, Rs.75,000 per month + Rs.10,000 per month conveyance for Special Judicial Magistrate of II-Class at Markapur, Rs.75,000 per month + Rs.10,000 per month conveyance for I-Special Judicial Magistrate of II-Class at Ongole.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired or resigned AP State Judicial Service officer; or AP Judicial Ministerial Service (not below Superintendent) or AP High Court Service (Section Officer and above) with Law Degree; or Advocate with at least 5 years' practice, at present not on the rolls of the Bar Council; or retired Gazetted Officer with Law Degree or Criminal Judicial Test and 3 years' Magisterial powers. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Advocates applying under clause (iv) must be non-practising and at present not on the rolls of the Bar Council. Unit of appointment is the candidate's own Judicial District.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A practising advocate. A member of any State or Legal Authority, the State Legislature or Parliament. A person dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired, or given a major penalty for misconduct, from State, Union or local authority service. A person convicted of an offence involving moral delinquency, or charged with an offence of moral turpitude with proceedings pending.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection based on eligibility and preference to retired Judicial Officers.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Courts at Sl.No.8 to 11 are sanctioned under the 13th Finance Commission; their term is till 31-03-2027. Court work 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, 7.30 am to 10.30 am. Casual Leave not exceeding 15 days in a calendar year; no other kind of leave.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by District Judiciary Prakasam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Chirala, Giddalur, Kandukur, Markapur, Ongole, Addanki, Darsi, Kanigiri and Podili.
